The branch adds 1024-entry oldest-entry pruning to Google Chat approval-card token bindings and manual follow-up suppression registries, plus focused eviction coverage.

PR surface: Source +14, Tests +69. Total +83 across 2 files.

target.title: fix(googlechat): cap approval binding registries
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes two unbounded in-process Maps in the Google Chat approval flow:

1. **`approvalCardBindings`** — maps approval tokens to in-flight native Google Chat interactive card state. No eviction path; on a long-lived gateway with high approval-card throughput this Map grows without limit.
2. **`manualApprovalFollowupSuppressions`** — tracks approval IDs to suppress duplicate follow-up text after native card delivery. Same unbounded growth pattern.

## Why This Change Was Made

Applies `pruneMapToMaxSize` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/collection-runtime` immediately after every `.set` call on both Maps, each capped at **1 024 entries** with LRU eviction. An evicted binding simply cannot be resolved — the same behavior as a gateway restart.

## User Impact

Operators running Google Chat channels with high approval-card volume on long-lived gateways get bounded memory for both registries. Behavior is unchanged for the first 1 024 simultaneous in-flight approval cards.

## Evidence

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run \
  --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-messaging.config.ts \
  extensions/googlechat/src/approval-card-actions.test.ts \
  --reporter=verbose
```

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:** Google Chat approval-card bindings and manual follow-up suppressions grew without bound in long-lived gateway processes under high approval-card throughput.
- **Real environment tested:** macOS (Darwin arm64), Node.js v22.22.0, local source checkout on branch `fix/googlechat-cap-approval-bindings`.
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**
  1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config test/vitest/vitest.extension-messaging.config.ts extensions/googlechat/src/approval-card-actions.test.ts --reporter=verbose`
- **Evidence after fix:**

```text
 ✓ evicts oldest approval card bindings once the cache exceeds its cap
 ✓ evicts oldest manual approval follow-up suppressions once the cache exceeds its cap

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  6 passed (6)
```

- **Observed result after fix:** Regression tests register 1 025 entries against production registry helpers and confirm the oldest approval-card binding and manual follow-up suppression are evicted while the newest entries remain resolvable.
- **What was not tested:** Live Google Chat native approval card delivery or click handling against the Google Chat API.
